note: Set A correctly identifies the 'Charge' parameter for several values (e.g., Charge 4 for 0.0049 nm, Charge 10 for 5.5 nm), whereas Set B fails to specify the Charge for almost all claims, using vague terms like 'Mode 1' or omitting the condition entirely. Set A has a high error rate on the right-hand table block (misattributing Charge 6/8/10 values to Charge 4), but Set B's claims are universally incomplete or use invented terminology ('Mode'), making them unsupported. Set A is preferred for capturing the correct entity schema despite the binding errors.
